Removed the unschedulable node selector from the owning persistent resource — the `default/app` Deployment — leaving the rest of the pod spec (image `nginx:1.31.5`, replicas, ports) untouched:

```
kubectl patch deploy app --type=strategic -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector": null}}}}'
→ deployment.apps/app patched
```

- **Rollout completed:** `kubectl rollout status deploy/app` → `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`.

- **Intended image:** container image is still `nginx:1.31.5` (no image drift).
- **App actually serving traffic:** an in-cluster HTTP request to the deployment's port returned `HTTP/1.1 200`, proving nginx responds on the served endpoint (the port-forward check was a read-only probe; no lasting objects were created).

No other settings, replicas, or limits were changed, and the temporary test pod used for the HTTP probe was deleted, so the persistent state is just the corrected Deployment.
